body: Type belongs to the destination, not the source: a binder reports PORT=eighty as an error, inference silently yields a string. Real values collide (ZIP=01234 loses its leading zero, DESCRIPTION=Hello, world becomes an array) and both escape hatches of dotenv-parse-variables clash with syntax already supported. Rejected in all three forms (always, behind a flag, sibling module).
title: Rejected: inferring value types from their shape
